name: SpeedrunPlanning_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about gaming.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Computer noise and keyboard clicks in the background

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative philosophical discussion with alternating turns where users discuss philosophical statements referencing todays day and age.

setting.background: They are interested in improving their time without immediately pursuing a serious record

scenario_template.note: They jokingly compete over small improvements. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Losing too much time in specific sections
scenario_template.note: They cannot tell which improvements are most valuable. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
They want an achievable training plan. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Breaking the run into practice segments
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They debate whether faster techniques are worth practicing. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

Assistant suggests ways to learn from resets without burning out. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Setting a realistic next time goal
scenario_template.note: They agree on a modest improvement target. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to improve at a game but has limited experience with its mechanics, strategies, or systems and can become overwhelmed when faced with many choices, unfamiliar terminology, or complex objectives.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan strategies and optimize gameplay, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check approaches, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar game mechanics or uncertain outcomes.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
